snippet.title: Echoes of Aincrad | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
RISK YOUR REALITY

Set foot in the world of Aincrad, where one mistake can mean death.
 
Create your own character, tackle the floating castle of Aincrad with other adventurers you encounter along the way, and find your way out this game.

Echoes of Aincrad comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam on July 10th, 2026. 
Pre-order today: https://bnent.eu/Preorder-EchoesOfAincrad
